title: Western Star 4800/4900 FUPS Bullbar #9
description: Western Star hi-tensile aluminium polished Bullbar for 4800/4900 series. Five post design. Tow plate cover is black but other finishes available or chrome plated. Reversible aluminium Road Train signs, lower cow catcher with one small centre mounted upright. Built with 88mm diameter pipe. Custom driving light mounts as required, bar mounted indicator repeater light. Heavy duty backing plate with tow pin, ideal for dolly work. Front mudflap bar standard. Dangerous Goods signs are optional.
